content.rationale: S5-marker-file fixes where the file is — markers.json in the state directory, `.deccy/markers.json` — and S5-markers-persist (nslkynln) and S5-marker-schema (zwurlynr) that the markers and the position live in that one file across invocations; S5-marker-load fixes reading every marker in file order, S5-marker-initial that a missing file reads as empty, and S5-marker-corrupt that a marker file which cannot be read as valid refuses, naming the corruption; S5-marker-schema fixes the file's contents, so a load parses with M-markers' closed types (I1-serde) and checks the parsed document against the schema the binary carries, embedded with `include_str!` (I1-schema, I1-schema-embed). The linear history (kpptprql) fixes the position that round-trips beside the markers. It reads and writes the file through M-markers-file (qvkrwptt), whose read yields the contents as they stand — nothing when the file is not there, so a missing file reads as empty (S5-marker-initial), while a file that is there yields its contents even when they are empty — and whose write replaces them atomically — never a bare truncate — and this module carries the reason and never renders it.
